limitations: Most runtime and frameworks remain C/C++/assembly; no original target retired.
Only x86_64 Rust integration executes; original i386 binary is preserved at the pinned link gate.
Clean pinned full-runtime startup remains unverified; local server RPC differences require matching objects.
Process-query permissions retain Darling server model, not full macOS authorization parity.
Remaining legacy process flavors and unsupported accounting fields are documented in crate SAFETY.txt.
CGShadingCreate requires explicit repair of malformed upstream nib references in copied resources.
Non-null invalid guest pointers remain subject to existing runtime caller contracts.
cfbridge timestamp normalization is explicit; the strict app harness still exits 1 for that known line and original failures.
